lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in a structured grid posterior to the gill slits. A prominent vertical column of four primary centroids is visible immediately aft of the fifth gill slit, aligned with horizontal rows extending posteriorly along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are observable, aligning with the vertical columns of spots. These intersect with the horizontal carinae and rows of spots to form a rectilinear pattern of nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank. The uppermost ridge shows a sharp luminance transition from light to dark moving ventrally. These trajectories are approximately parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, circular high-luminance blobs. These are concentrated primarily along the anterior margin and the lower half of the fin silhouette, with lower density towards the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a significantly higher density of smaller, more tightly packed high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank pattern.
